acceptance.item: P6-RT-02-01: B2 and C2: T13 applies the C2 adjustment of SPEC 6.4 in site code instead of taking its display records from satakeRecord
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T13.test.ts > regressions > RT-02 p6 attack 13: the C2 naming of SPEC 6.4 is applied by satakeRecord only > t13/model.ts does not apply the C2 adjustment itself (with the satakeRecord comparison test and the E7/E8 test in the same block)
acceptance.evidence: severity minor (no adjustment). Red at base 0436a53: 1 failed (model.ts:445, 446, 447 listed), matching the verifier. Cause: assembleData rebuilt restricted_board and the Bourbaki orbits from satake and applied the C2 rule a second time. Fix: displayRecord takes them from satakeRecord on the reader's own pair; when matchCatalogue's record already is of the reader's pair it is reused, so E7/E8 never run satakeRecord on the main thread (only D4, D6, D8 have such symmetry images). Green: 52 passed; every existing field-by-field golden test still passes. The E7/E8 test fails under the mutant that always calls satakeRecord. Commit bfbdad0.

acceptance.item: P6-RT-02-02: Position for label: T13 converts the labels of the drawn restricted board to array indices with l - 1, k - 1 and k + 1 outside toLabels/toPositions
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T13.test.ts > regressions > RT-02 p6: T13 converts restricted-board labels only through toLabels and toPositions (E-7) > no label arithmetic on the drawn restricted board
acceptance.evidence: severity minor (no adjustment). Red at base: 1 failed listing the 12 lines, matching the verifier. Cause: drawing arrays are indexed by the drawn board's positions, but labels were turned into indices by hand. Fix: drawnPosition and drawnLabel in model.ts (toPositions/toLabels on boardFromName of the drawing's name); position-indexed arrays are passed as they are. Green: 52 passed; the golden-based multiplicities, node-name and composite tests still pass. Commit 0269376.

acceptance.item: P6-RT-10-05: T13's node buttons carry data-board values 'decoration' and 'restricted' and data-value 'black' and 'white', outside the hooks of 4.0
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T13.spec.ts > regressions > RT-10 p6: every node button of T13 carries the hooks of 4.0 with legal values
acceptance.evidence: original minor, raised to major by the refuter. Red on the base build: '14 node buttons; outside 4.0: data-board="decoration" data-value="white", ... "black", data-board="restricted" data-value="0", ... "1"', matching the verifier. Fix: paint buttons data-board="numbers" with data-value 1 (black, filled) or 0 (white, hollow), colour kept in data-colour; restricted board data-board="populations" (SPEC 2.15). The existing hooks test of T13.spec.ts now expects the new values and also asserts data-value against data-colour; the M9.spec.ts header comment is updated. No other test read the old values. The fragment records that this replaces the hooks part of the P6-A3 entry. Green on the fixed build. Commit ba3dba8.

deviations.what: satakeRecord is now called by assembleData on the main thread, for a pair that is a symmetry image of a catalogue pair. This happens only on D4, D6 and D8. P6-A3's 'where the Satake data are computed' entry said satakeRecord is not called, and its 'C2 drawing rule' entry applied the adjustment in site code. Both sentences are replaced in decisions/RT-FIX-P6-t13.md. The data path of load.ts is unchanged, and its test still asserts no satakeRecord call there.
deviations.why: SPEC 6.4 and Appendix H: records for display come from satakeRecord. E-9 is kept because E7 and E8 never reach the call; a unit test guards this. Measured cost in Node: 4 to 29 ms on D8 depending on load.

deviations.what: T13.spec.ts 'every node button carries data-node, data-board, ...' now expects data-board 'numbers' on the decoration (was 'decoration') and 'populations' on the restricted board (was 'restricted'). It also gains a data-value check.
deviations.why: The old values were the defect of P6-RT-10-05, and the orchestrator asked for every test reading the old hooks to be updated. The test is stronger, not weaker.

openQuestions: Challenge.svelte reads every [data-node] of a tool, grouped by data-board. With the restricted board now 'populations', a reach, distinct or mixed-signs check on a T13 instance would mix the game board with the restricted board while that panel is open. No lesson has such a check today: M9's three T13 Challenges are of kind 'out'. The lens's 'separate group hook for Challenge' would be a change under site/src/components/lesson/, which is outside this cluster.

The engine suite times out at the default 5000 ms on 2 or 3 unchanged tests (mainthread-fast-paths, p7-roots-signs, satake-coordinates, p6a-restricted) at load 16 to 28 on 4 CPUs. This happens both at baseline and after; with --testTimeout=60000 all 2728 pass. No engine file is changed.
The T13 axe test (30 s) timed out once at load 21 to 25 and passed alone (28.3 s; base 27.9 s). This is load-bound, as the verifier also saw.
registry-outs.spec.ts reads site/dist directly and ignores OUT_DIR, so it fails for an OUT_DIR build. It passed (35) against site/dist.
handoff: Every changed file is inside the t13 cluster, plus a one-line header comment in M9.spec.ts and the fragment. No other cluster's file, and no ToolFrame, Predict, nojs or worker file, was touched. All seven findings are fixed. The lens should know three things. (1) For P6-RT-02-01 I followed the proposed fix with one addition: matchCatalogue's own record is reused when its pair is the reader's, so that E7/E8 stay off the main thread. (2) For P6-RT-10-05 the paint buttons take data-board="numbers" with values 1/0 (data-colour unchanged); the Challenge group hook is logged under openQuestions, not built. (3) The table view gains the hook data-table-population. Size: link states drop from 92298 to 87208 B, and bare routes go from 87.1 to 87.2 kB.
